Mark ar report items as reviewed against their sources' current runs

Source: R/ar-file.R
ar_review.Rd

After rereading an item's methods, results and interpretation against a source job that has been rendered again, ar_review() moves that item's review stamp to the job's current run, which clears the report's callout. The analyst's text is not changed.

Usage

ar_review(path, item = NULL, root = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the ar job file.

item

Item ids to stamp, such as "hz.dead.hz#fig-fit". NULL stamps every item.

root

The study root. NULL finds it above path.

Value

The ids of the items stamped, invisibly.

See also

ar_paste_methods

Examples

# \donttest{
# ar_review("documents/ar.dead.question.qmd", "hz.dead.hz#fig-fit")
# }
